text:
Hi there,

I've got a bit of a soft spot for classic cars, and that's why I'm reaching out to you - I'd love to hire the 1954 Wexcombe Regent for a corporate event we're hosting next year. My friends and I have always been fascinated by vintage cars, and I've even managed to restore an old Triumph of my own in my garage. Anyway, back to the Regent - we're planning to pick it up on 10th August 2027 at 08:00 and bring it back on Wednesday 11 August 2027 at 5:30 pm. We'll collect it from your garage, and we'd greatly appreciate it if we could have a chauffeur to drive it for us. 

Thanks,
Milo Oakhampstead +70 262 530 6048
